title: What the Palantir CEO’s ‘manifesto’ tells us about the changing face of war
summary: A Palantir post citing CEO Alex Karp's book called for mandatory military service and closer ties between Silicon Valley and the Pentagon while criticizing "hollow pluralism" and warning of a new AI arms race.
